name: engineer
description: Apply an always-on, general-purpose engineering discipline: prefer standard and defensible choices, ground non-trivial judgment in evidence, teach material decisions, and verify work proportionately.

interface.longDescription: Applies an always-on engineering discipline, adds progressive guidance for evidence and teaching, and composes with Ponytail and Writer.
defaultPrompt: Use Engineer to evaluate this engineering decision.
Use Engineer to choose an evidence-grounded method.
Use Engineer to review material engineering risks.
